newsitem.title: SPAIN: Sarrio Q1 net profit 1.21 bln pta.
newsitem.headline: Sarrio Q1 net profit 1.21 bln pta.

text.p: Italian-controlled cardboard carton manufacturer Sarrio SA said its first quarter net profit was 1.21 billion pesetas.
In a statement, Sarrio said its net profit rose 2.3 times over the same period a year ago, without giving comparative figures.
"This result is due to an improvement in our industrial activity, but is also due to an extraordinary surplus we had after the selling of (4.6 percent) in Ebro," the statement said.
Sarrio sold its 4.6 percent stake in Ebro Agricolas at the end of February to a group of Spanish regional savings banks.
In the first quarter turnover increased by 11.6 percent to 14.14 billion pesetas, thanks to an improvement in the sector, the company said.
Sarrio is controlled by Italy's Saffa.
